title: Add component tests for TodoInput, TodoItem, TodoList, and TodoFooter
active_form: Adding component tests for TodoInput, TodoItem, TodoList, and TodoFooter
description:
Write Vitest + React Testing Library component tests for all UI components. Test TodoInput: submission via Enter and button, empty/whitespace rejection, input clearing. Test TodoItem: checkbox toggle, delete button, double-click edit mode, Enter/Escape/blur behavior in edit mode, completed todo styling and edit blocking, empty edit deletion. Test TodoList: filtering (all/active/completed), empty state rendering. Test TodoFooter: active count pluralization, filter button highlighting, clear completed visibility, toggle all behavior, footer visibility.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Section 3.2, 9.1

functional: TodoInput tests: Enter submission, button submission, input clearing
TodoItem tests: checkbox toggle, delete button, inline editing lifecycle
TodoList tests: renders filtered todos, empty state
TodoFooter tests: count display, filter buttons, clear completed, toggle all
edge_cases: TodoItem: empty edit text triggers deletion
TodoItem: completed todo blocks edit mode
TodoFooter: clear completed button hidden when no completed todos

testing_requirements.target: TodoItem toggle, delete, and full inline editing lifecycle
TodoFooter count, filters, clear completed, and toggle all
